fullDescription: A high-conversion service marketplace mobile UI featuring a warm, orange-accented palette, rounded aesthetics, and a clean, modern layout. It utilizes the Plus Jakarta Sans font family for a premium feel. The design is optimized for home services, SaaS booking platforms, and gig economy apps. Key features include an auto-rotating promotional carousel with gradient overlays, horizontal snap-scrolling job cards with progress tracking, and a categorical grid of services. The interface emphasizes accessibility through high-contrast text and intuitive iconography, incorporating smooth transitions and 24px corner radii for a friendly, approachable brand identity.
prompt:
## Resumo
A sophisticated mobile service booking home screen featuring a warm orange color scheme (#f97316), heavy use of rounded corners (24px to 32px), and a dynamic promotional carousel. The layout is optimized for vertical scrolling with horizontal snap-points for active tasks, promoting high user engagement through visual hierarchy and micro-interactions.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system using 'Plus Jakarta Sans'. Colors: Background #fafafa, Primary Orange #f97316, Secondary Orange #fff7ed, Text Primary #1a1a1a, Text Secondary #6b7280. Spacing: 24px (1.5rem) standard container padding. Corners: 24px for cards/carousel, 32px for category buttons, 12px for small badges. Typography: Page Titles (20px, Bold), Section Headers (18px, Bold), Body (14px, Medium), Captions (11px, Regular), Tiny Labels (9px-10px, Bold Uppercase). Shadows: 'active-job-shadow' (0 12px 24px -8px rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.15)). Animations: 4000ms carousel interval with 700ms ease-in-out slide transitions.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header
Create a profile greeting header. Top padding 56px, horizontal padding 24px. Left side: Greeting text 'Good morning' in #6b7280 (14px) above username in #1a1a1a (20px, Bold). Right side: 44px circular notification bell button (#f9fafb background) with a 10px orange (#f97316) dot indicator at the top right.

### Promotional Carousel
Full-width carousel with 24px horizontal margins. Height 176px. Slides have 24px rounded corners. Each slide features a hero image with a bottom-heavy black gradient overlay (from-black/90 to-transparent). Content includes Title (18px, Bold White), Description (11px, White/80), and a 'Sponsored' tag (9px, Bold Orange, Uppercase). Navigation: Bottom-right aligned dots; active dot is 16px pill-shaped, inactive dots are 6px circles.

### Active Jobs Section
Horizontal scrolling section with snap-to-center behavior. Title 'Active Jobs' (18px, Bold) with 'View all' link in orange. Cards are 320px wide, white background, orange-100 border, 24px padding. Includes service icon in 40px rounded box, progress bar (6px height), 'Track Service' button (14px, Bold White on Orange), and percentage indicator.

### Search and Category Filters
Sticky-feel search bar with 24px margins. Input: #f3f4f6 background, 16px radius, search icon left-aligned. Below, a horizontal scroll of pill-shaped filter buttons. Active state: Orange background, white text. Inactive state: White background, gray-100 border, gray-600 text.

### Service Grid
Two-column CSS grid with 16px gap. Each card is a white 24px-32px rounded container. Top: 56px rounded-square icon container with category-specific light tint (e.g., amber-50 for Carpentry, blue-50 for Plumbing). Center: Bold 14px title. Bottom: 10px star rating and count in gray-400.

### Bottom Navigation
Fixed 80px height footer, white background, gray-100 top border. Four flex-items. Each item has a 20px icon and 10px label. Active item: Orange (#f97316) with Bold label. Inactive items: Gray-400 with Medium weight label.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Dynamic Ad Navigation Dots — An interactive pagination indicator for carousels where the active dot expands into a pill shape.
Container: absolute position bottom-4, right-6. Flex-row, gap 6px. Dots: Inactive dots are 6px x 6px circles, background white/40. Active dot: 16px x 6px pill-shape, background white. Transition: width 300ms, background-color 300ms.

### Service Category Card — Highly tactile, interactive grid items for service selection.
Container: background #ffffff, border 1px solid #f3f4f6, padding 16px, border-radius 32px. Hover/Active: scale 95% with ease transition. Content: 56px icon box with specific palette: Carpentry (amber), Electrician (yellow), Plumbing (blue), Cleaning (emerald), Painting (rose), HVAC (indigo). Icon color matches the darkest shade of the palette.

## Notas Especiais
Maintain strict 24px horizontal padding for all major sections to ensure alignment. The carousel must auto-rotate every 4 seconds to maintain dynamism. Category cards must use specific light pastel backgrounds corresponding to their icon colors to avoid visual fatigue. Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' to preserve the modern brand identity. Do not use sharp corners anywhere; everything must be rounded to at least 8px.

The primary color is a vibrant orange (#f97316) paired with subtle background tints. Components feature soft shadows (0 12px 24px -8px rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.15)) and generous border radii. Transitions are fluid, using a 700ms ease-in-out timing for major movements like the carousel.
